## What it is

Boîtier de dérivation coffeeflow assemblé : boîte + couvercle, trois Wago 221-423 en contexte, plaque stand-in du châssis Profitec Go (aimants, ~40–50 °C).

## Design notes

The lid is modelled top-down for printing. The assembly flips it 180° around X so the skirt drops into the box. `ouvert` lifts the lid without unscrewing anything, which is only a viewing aid.

The chassis plate is a rough stand-in: two millimetres of steel-sized box under the floor, not a scan of the machine.

## Don't

- Do not treat `ouvert` as a printable motion. The lid is held by two M3 screws, not a hinge.
- Assembly parameters arrive as nurb `_Named` floats: cast them with `float()` before arithmetic or `dims()`.

## Changelog

- First assembly: box, lid, three Wagos on the standoffs, chassis under the magnets.
